rule: This template is filled and signed by an independent security reviewer (not the remediation author). C7 remains PARTIAL until every item is signed with verifiable evidence.
scope: Separation of duties: verifier has no keys, reads no secrets, creates no signature, sends nothing.
Private-key management: no plaintext password/keystore file in any reviewed path; no --private-key in any live path.
Environment permissions and tool provenance (trust-root enforcement, hash-verified binaries).
Signing / commitIntent / anchorProof paths: currently absent from any executable surface.
Negative proof: broadcast path is unavailable before explicit owner authorization.

items.requirement: Assurance engine is verification-only (no exec/net/dynamic sites)
items.evidenceRequired: SELF-002 = PASS in release/verification-report.json; reviewer re-runs -SelfTest and sees ST21 pass

items.requirement: No secret material in review package or scanned roots
items.evidenceRequired: SEC-001 = PASS (roots + hits recorded in report evidence); reviewer spot-checks scan roots

items.requirement: No legacy --private-key / cast send executable surface
items.evidenceRequired: LEG-001 = PASS (hits:[]); legacy-quarantine/ exists with 18 preserved files; npm run anchor blocked

items.requirement: cast binary within trust root, hash pre-approved, provenance documented
items.evidenceRequired: ENV-002/ENV-003 = PASS; V06-2 record (source hash, official foundry 1.8.0 release, Authenticode-unsigned exception note)

items.requirement: No signing/broadcast capability exists in the reviewed toolchain
items.evidenceRequired: grep/AST review of engine + kit: no cast send, no eth_sendRawTransaction, no keystore import; authorization block all NOT AUTHORIZED

items.requirement: Manifest integrity chain intact and non-circular
items.evidenceRequired: MAN-001/MAN-002 = PASS; approved-evidence-manifest 8/8 MATCH; manifest.sha256 matches manifest.json

c7OutcomeRule: C7 = PASS only when all items are signed PASS with independent evidence. Any PENDING/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE keeps C7 = PARTIAL. C7 closure does NOT grant GO (C8 + C9 + explicit owner GO still required).
